jp: 手紙に指示されている場所は
ここみたいだけど・・・
en: The place the letter named seems to be here, but...
...Hey, someone's collapsed over there!!
Uuh...
Stay with me... I'll tend to you right away.
Oh my, this person is...

jp: リリス会ったことあるもん
en: This lady is from the Church. Lilis has met her before.

jp: ここで何かあったのは
en: Something certainly happened here.

jp: いくつかの足跡が残っている
en: Several sets of footprints left behind. These are the Church's people, no mistake.

jp: 捕らえられてしまいました
en: ...That child.. has been captured by the Church, as a heretic.

jp: あの子を呼び出したばかりに・・
en: Because I... I called her out here..

jp: ステイエンを呼び出した？
en: You called Stayen out?

jp: ステイエンに渡された手紙の
差出人はアンタなのか？
en: Then the letter Stayen got... you're the one who sent it?
...Yes.

jp: ここで何があったんですか？
en: What on earth happened here?
It is all my fault.

jp: 私達の弟が危険な実験に
en: I learned our little brother was to be used in a dangerous experiment,
and to tell her so, I called Stayen here. But

jp: ステイエンをおびき出すための
en: it was all a trap to lure Stayen out,

jp: 天使グリシナが仕組んだ
en: laid by the angel Grisina...

jp: 見張られていた私は、結果的に
あの子が捕らわれるのに、
手を貸してしまったのです
en: I was being watched, and in the end I helped them capture that child.

jp: ステイエンはいったいどこに？
en: ...Um. Where is Stayen now?

jp: 連行されてしまいました
en: She was taken away to Leniam Plaza.

jp: 全ては私の浅はかな行いが
en: All of this is the result of my own foolish actions.

jp: 助けに行かなくては・・・
en: I have to go and save that child...

jp: アンタは教団の一員なんだろ？
en: Hold on a sec! You're a member of the Church, aren't you?

jp: 異端者を助けたりして
en: Is it safe for you to go rescuing a heretic?

jp: 死なせるわけには・・・
en: But I can't just let that child die...

jp: 大丈夫、ステイエンのことなら
en: It's okay. Leave Stayen to us.
But...
Tch... Far too simple-minded.
...True.

jp: 全てが教団の手の込んだ罠って
en: This woman included, the whole thing could be an elaborate Church trap, you know?

jp: でも、ステイエンに何かあった
en: But something's definitely happened to Stayen.

jp: 捕まろうが、だまされようが
それを回避できなかったのは
en: Captured or deceived, failing to avoid it was her own responsibility.

jp: それに振り回されなければ
en: Why should we have to be dragged around by it?
Th... that's...

jp: この先誰が死のうとも、
お前が責任を感じることはない
en: No matter who dies from here on, you need not feel responsible.

jp: 皆、誰に強制されるでもなく
自分の意志で動いている
en: No one is forced. We all act of our own will.

jp: ステイエンを死なせたくない！
en: I don't want Stayen to die! We're going to save her, no matter what!

jp: ステイエンが死ぬって決まった
en: H-hey now, Cain. It's not like Stayen's dying is a sure thing.

jp: でも・・・でもっ・・・
en: But... but...

jp: お前らは甘過ぎるんだ！
教団と敵対しているんだぞ！
en: You lot are too soft! We're at war with the Church, you know!

jp: 感情に任せて行動してどうする？
この女がウソをついているとは
en: What good is acting on feeling? Hasn't it occurred to you this woman might be lying?!

jp: 教団に身を置く者にも
さまざまな事情があります
en: Those in the Church, like this lady and myself, each have their own circumstances.

jp: 教団の人間だからといって
信用できないと断じるのは
en: To judge someone untrustworthy simply for belonging to the Church is a mistake.

jp: あの、貴方はもしや・・
en: Um, could you be...
Yes. I too once belonged to the Prodevon Church.
My name is Syria.
Um... is something wrong?
No...

jp: この方がベイル様の・・・
en: So this is the one Bale-sama...
Time's wasting, everyone. Let's get moving!

jp: 行くならお前らだけで行け、
つきあいきれん・・・
en: If you're going, go by yourselves. I've had enough of this...
Zion!!

jp: いいじゃないザイオン、
en: Oh, come on, Zion.

jp: あんな小うるさい小娘でも
いないと物足りないのよね
en: Even that mouthy little brat... it's not the same without her around.
Luca...
Settled, then! If Luca's going, you can't stay behind alone, right?
Tch...

jp: レニアム坂広場で待つ
en: Please wait! At Grisina's side, waiting in Leniam Plaza,

jp: レッド・ムフロン様が居ます！
en: there will most likely be one of the Ten Tribunal Generals, Red Mouflon-sama!
Please...

jp: あの方と争うことになるなら
ステイエンのことは諦めて
すぐに引き返して下さい！！
en: If it means fighting Red Mouflon-sama, give up on Stayen and turn back at once!!

jp: ありがとう、俺たちの心配まで
en: Cardia-san.. Thanks. You're even worrying about us.

jp: 俺たちのこと、妹をたぶらかした
アヤシイ奴らって思わないのか？
en: You don't think we're some shady bunch who led your sister astray?

jp: そんな・・・一本気な妹が
信用して身を寄せている皆さん
です、疑うなんて・・・
en: No... My headstrong sister trusts you, lives among you. How could I doubt you...

jp: へへっ、そんな風に言われると
なんだか照れちまうな
en: Heh heh. Hearing it put like that kinda makes me blush.

jp: 例え十審将が待っていようと
ボクたちは引き下がらない
en: Cardia-san. Even if a Tribunal General is waiting, we won't back down.

jp: 絶対大丈夫とは言えないけれど
en: I can't promise it'll be okay for sure,

jp: このままステイエンと会えなく
なるなんて、嫌だから・・・
en: but I couldn't stand never seeing Stayen again...
Everyone...

jp: ボク達にできることを
せいいっぱいやってきます
en: We'll go and do everything we can.
Thank you...

jp: どうかよろしくお願いします
en: Those children... Please, I beg you, look after them.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
